evidence.fact: 4,600' of climbing from the parking lot to summit via NE Rib.
Route NE Rib '51 variation; gain on way in 4811 ft from a 3400 ft start.

note: 4811 is within 10% of BOTH 4600 (4.4%) and stored 5000 (3.8%); 4600 vs 5000 also agree (8%). Peakbagger figures equal summit minus start (net), which fits this route (straight up from the road, no intermediate loss). Final = the route-precise page, Abegg 4600. No closure seen.

Peakbagger ascent 2019-07-26 (Osborn): gain on way in 4458 ft, start 3200 ft, 14 mi; route not stated.

evidence.fact: Mountaineers Magic Mountain South Ridge: elevation gain 4,000 ft from Cascade Pass TH.
Gain on way in 4158 ft from a 3500 ft trailhead (within 3.8% of 4,000).

note: WEAK agreement: both Peakbagger entries equal summit (7658) minus start exactly, i.e. net, and name no route; Osborn's 4458 agrees with stored 4800 (7.1%) but not 4000 (10.3%). The route crosses Cache Col (6,900) and descends to Kool-Aid Lake (6,120) per the Mountaineers page, so a net figure likely understates cumulative gain. Treat as provisional; owner may prefer unresolved.

evidence.fact: Mountaineers Eagle Rock: elevation gain 1,400 ft.
Trailhead end of road 4110 ft; elevation gain 1504 ft to the 5,614 ft summit (simple up-and-back).

note: 1504 is within 10% of both 1400 (6.9%) and stored 1464 (2.7%); either value is supported. Slayden's figure is labelled total gain but the outing is a plain up-and-back with no intermediate climbs, so it is the trailhead-to-summit gain (equals summit minus TH). Access: 10+ mi of rough road to the high TH, high-clearance 4x4 advised (Slayden 2019).

Mullen 2024: up Blanca Lake and Columbia Glacier; gain on way in 6522 ft (net 5322 + 1200 extra), 8.8 mi.
Standard (Virgin Lake ridge) route, Total Ascent 6023 ft, 13.8 mi - a whole-outing GPS total, not one-way, different route.

evidence.fact: Mountaineers Kyes Peak: elevation gain 6,500 ft from Blanca Lake TH.
Blanca Lake + Columbia Glacier route, start 1960 ft: gain on way in 6522 ft.

note: Stored 6023 matches washingtonstatehiking.com's round-trip Total Ascent for the STANDARD ridge route, so it is a different route and scope. The glacier route drops ~1,200 ft to Blanca Lake on the way in, which is why it gains more. Climber Kyle (2025) notes the North Fork Skykomish River Road has reopened; Mountaineers page still carries a closure note - check before use.

figures.fact: 'Mount Olympus Traverse: 45 miles with 8,100 feet' - whole multi-peak traverse outing.
East Peak + Athena via Glacier Pass (not the W-M-E traverse); gain on way in 7149 ft, 50.4 mi, multi-peak.
NPS gives only 'Elevation change: 4,400 feet to 7,980 feet', 4-6 mi from Glacier Meadows - camp-based, no TH figure.

note: The route is inherently multi-peak (West, Middle, East), which rule 3 excludes, and no page states a trailhead-to-final-summit one-way gain for it. Peakbagger Middle/East Peak ascent lists hold no traverse entry with a usable gain; Olympus main-peak 2025 entries (7,396-15,475) mix routes and whole-trip totals. Neither 10,700 nor 8,100 is supported as a one-way figure.
